product.name: NeClip
product.summary: Local clipboard history, snippets and safe EN/RU layout correction for macOS

features: snippet folders directly in both menus, without duplicated quick entries or implicit first-item commands
no new pins; protected legacy clips remain accessible with explicit warned unpinning
Option-click inspects the chosen clip without pasting; draft-to-snippet creation is atomic
stable folder order and no usage write or refresh on snippet paste
immediate-use history and folder snippets without search or keyword fields
selective menu refresh with stale-result rejection and retry on explicit open
compact retention controls with visible active-cleanup indicator
distribution binaries stripped after saving UUID-matched private debug symbols
native macOS Settings toolbar with five persistent categories
numeric setting drafts commit on explicit completion rather than partial keystrokes
draft-safe history editing, save-on-close choices and stale-load rejection
native About, Settings and responder-chain Edit commands
physical-key menu commands across English and Russian layouts
scrollable first-run help with always-reachable permission and continue actions
folder-first snippet hotkey and right-click menu-bar access
direct snippet editing, duplicate and deletion undo
bounded nonrecursive snippet placeholders with ISO formats and literal escaping
individual shortcut reset and live settings state
clipboard history for text, images and files
discoverable editable snippet folders, starter snippets and local placeholders
manual EN/RU layout correction with a configurable shortcut
optional conservative automatic EN/RU correction
per-application input-source memory without keyboard monitoring
fixed per-application input source without keyboard monitoring
one-shot append of the next accepted text
session ignore after undoing a false automatic correction
off-only automatic-correction safety shortcut
direct recent-history sequential paste
five configurable conflict-safe global shortcuts
sectioned local settings
configurable grapheme-safe menu label length
atomic local history and snippet erasure
partial or on-quit history cleanup and bounded text capture
race-free clear-on-quit after queued capture drain
bounded local storage and privacy exclusions
immutable password-manager capture protection and quick per-app capture rules
bounded snippet summaries with one-body-at-a-time loading
lossless fail-closed pasteboard restoration
self-verifying complete-ref and pull-request-ref secret scanning
native snippet-list selection with visible-order keyboard navigation
atomic provenance-bound local release staging

permissions.pasteboard: Explained before monitoring; denied access fails closed on macOS 15.4+
permissions.accessibility: Optional; used for one-click paste and manual selected-text replacement
permissions.inputMonitoring: Requested only when automatic layout correction is explicitly enabled; per-application layout memory does not need it

notPlanned: search, keyword fields, tags or smart collections
featuresVersion: 1.10.0 released; exact downloadable artifact is identified by version.json
